from __future__ import annotations
from dataclasses import dataclass


@dataclass(frozen=True)
class UserCreatedData:
    one_point_zero: str
    sci_hundred: str = None
    tenth: str = None
    tiny: str = None
    small: str = None
    edge_low: str = None
    big: str = None
    huge: str = None
    e21: str = None
    e20: str = None
    neg_zero: str = None
    neg_zero_f: str = None
    neg: str = None
    min_double: str = None
    max_double: str = None
    overflow: str = None
    cap_e: str = None
    third: str = None
    list: str = None
    plain: int | None = None

    @classmethod
    def from_dict(cls, data: dict[str, Any]) -> UserCreatedData:
        return cls(
            one_point_zero=data.get("onePointZero"),
            sci_hundred=data.get("sciHundred"),
            tenth=data.get("tenth"),
            tiny=data.get("tiny"),
            small=data.get("small"),
            edge_low=data.get("edgeLow"),
            big=data.get("big"),
            huge=data.get("huge"),
            e21=data.get("e21"),
            e20=data.get("e20"),
            neg_zero=data.get("negZero"),
            neg_zero_f=data.get("negZeroF"),
            neg=data.get("neg"),
            min_double=data.get("minDouble"),
            max_double=data.get("maxDouble"),
            overflow=data.get("overflow"),
            cap_e=data.get("capE"),
            third=data.get("third"),
            list=data.get("list"),
            plain=data.get("plain"),
        )

    def to_dict(self) -> dict[str, Any]:
        return {
            "onePointZero": self.one_point_zero,
            "sciHundred": self.sci_hundred,
            "tenth": self.tenth,
            "tiny": self.tiny,
            "small": self.small,
            "edgeLow": self.edge_low,
            "big": self.big,
            "huge": self.huge,
            "e21": self.e21,
            "e20": self.e20,
            "negZero": self.neg_zero,
            "negZeroF": self.neg_zero_f,
            "neg": self.neg,
            "minDouble": self.min_double,
            "maxDouble": self.max_double,
            "overflow": self.overflow,
            "capE": self.cap_e,
            "third": self.third,
            "list": self.list,
            "plain": self.plain,
        }
